Prospective Students
Discover Your Future in Physical Sciences at UC Irvine
Join a world-class academic community where curiosity meets innovation. At UC Irvine’s School of Physical Sciences, we prepare the next generation of scientists and leaders to tackle the most pressing challenges of our time, from climate change to quantum technologies. Whether you’re starting your undergraduate journey or advancing to graduate-level research, you’ll find a program that empowers you to make an impact.
Math Grad Virtual Info Session 2026:
The Math Department’s Info Session will be taking place on November 9th, 2026 from 4:00 pm – 5:00 pm PST. This session is an opportunity for prospective students to learn more about the graduate program. The event will feature faculty and student speakers from the department,
information about applying, and an opportunity to ask questions! The event will be hosted virtually over Zoom. If you are interested in attending, please see the below link to RSVP.

New Graduate Program: Master of Applied Artificial Intelligence for Science
ArtificiaI Intelligence is transforming how scientists work in industry. If you have a background in the physical or biological sciences and want to harness AI in your work, this nine-month full-time Master of Applied AI for Science is designed for you.
